purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-setup. S* queries must route to ugt-nextjs-setup; N* queries must NOT (their expected child target is informational). Rerun by giving a fresh model the plugin skill listing plus each query independently and asking which skill it would invoke first.
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors

baseline_result.note: optimizer loop terminated at iteration 0 — nothing to improve at ceiling
